name: octen
description: Real-time web search, broad multi-angle search, URL extraction, and UI design references for coding agents, powered by Octen.

interface.longDescription:
Octen gives ChatGPT and Codex live information from the web — real-time search infrastructure built for AI.

- Web search: ranked results with query-relevant highlights and clean full content — token-efficient and LLM-ready, no crawling or parsing needed. Minute-level index freshness (second-level for fast-moving data like stock prices and live sports), average latency as low as 62 ms, and sites in 100+ languages.
- News mode: a dedicated vertical for headlines and recent events, with time filters.
- Broad search: fans one question into multiple concurrent searches for research, comparisons, and landscape surveys.
- URL extract: turns 1-20 URLs into clean markdown for reading, summarizing, and grounding answers.
- Beta (invite-only): image search, video search, and curated UI design references with structured style tokens and reusable HTML/CSS snippets for building frontends.

Ask it to look something up, compare options with cited sources, read a page, or pull real design references before writing UI code.

Requires an OCTEN_API_KEY from https://octen.ai. The image, video, and design skills additionally require invite-only beta access (contact support@octen.ai).
defaultPrompt: Summarize this week's most important AI news, with sources.
Compare the leading cloud GPU providers on pricing and features, citing sources.
Find the official Node.js LTS release notes and summarize what changed.
